record.title: The Kings' Gate
record.premise: Bell Station's steward names Teku-Sul as the marked tower; the Toh-Wo makes the long dive, gets past the drowned priests' attendants to a great gate with three empty sockets, hears from a priest's ghost what the three seal-stones are and where each went, and is made a Reel-Ka by Never-Writes-Twice, who sends them after all three.
record.foundation: Built from the main plot (§5 quest 13, passed by the owner). The hunt, begun by MN11's report beside the player's own errand to Fort Chalkmoth (MN12); either may come first. The steward of Bell Station names Teku-Sul and marks it, and does not lead the player down; she sells potions of waterbreathing, and the Hist's blessing, a spell, an enchantment or being Argonian serves as well. If the steward is dead, the station's head diver names the tower instead, so neither is a who-must-live row. The tower's source, Teeth of Sithis, gives the East Xanmeer (the dry east halls, where the drowned priests' attendants walk), the Halls (the gallery and the great gate with three empty sockets, King of the Murkmire's crystal pedestals in a gate of its Xanmeer pieces) and the West Xanmeer behind the gate (for MN17 to MN19). The priest's ghost before the gate is the quest's one speaker who speaks first; his words say what a seal-stone is, where each went and that all three open the gate. The report to Never-Writes-Twice gives the rank of Reel-Ka (a cuirass and helm of Stormhold Warrior Armor under our name, free beds in every Archwarden fort and 300 gold) and marks the three places, starting MN14, MN15 and MN16 together. Who the quest cannot go on without: Never-Writes-Twice.

playerStart: The marker stone's marked tower is one of the drowned spires off Lilmoth, and the divers of Bell Station, on an islet east of Lilmoth, will know which (MN11).
The Eye of Argonia lies at the Root, behind a gate the old kings sealed (MN05).
The Unbound want the Eye and are brewing a draught to kill what guards the Root.
The player is a Toh-Wo; their own errand to Fort Chalkmoth (MN12) may be open or done.

facts.claim: The cut tower on the marker stone is Teku-Sul Spire, the drowned tower nearest Lilmoth, whose great gate Bell Station's divers have never forced.
The dive to Teku-Sul is long; a diver needs a Hist's blessing, a spell or potion of waterbreathing or an enchantment, unless they are Argonian; there is air inside the tower.
Three seal-stones, cut by the last king's priests, each fit one socket of the great gate; set all three and the gate opens to the Root.

One seal-stone lies in Blackrose Prison, where a masked thief who sought the Eye died in the cells and his stone went to the warden's vault; one in the flooded vaults of Gemin; one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl.
Never-Writes-Twice's orders are to take all three stones before the Unbound do.

topics.label: Which tower does this stone show? (the seven towers in the sea)
topics.intent: Meer-Tasi, steward of Bell Station. Tells: she knows the cut tower at once: Teku-Sul Spire, the drowned tower nearest Lilmoth, west of the station on the sea floor; her divers stripped its upper floors long ago; past its east halls stands a great gate with three empty sockets that nobody has forced, and divers say a priest's ghost stands before it; the dive is long and drowns the careless: take a Hist's blessing, a spell or potion of waterbreathing (she sells them) or an enchantment, unless you breathe water already; inside there is air; she will not send a diver down with the player. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 20.

topics.label: Which tower does this stone show?
topics.intent: Sees-Below, head diver, only while the steward is dead. Tells: the same as the steward: Teku-Sul, the nearest drowned tower, its sealed gate, the long dive and what keeps a diver breathing; the potions are in the steward's chest now. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 20.

topics.label: I'll buy potions of waterbreathing.
topics.intent: Meer-Tasi. Tells: she opens her stock; a potion of waterbreathing lasts long enough for the dive down if the diver does not dawdle; take two. Checks: nothing. Does: opens her trade.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: Meer-Tasi. Tells: steward of Bell Station for Lilmoth's merchant council; her crew dive the drowned spires and she weighs every find and sets aside the council's share. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Tell me about Teku-Sul.
topics.intent: Meer-Tasi. Tells: the spires stand on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, towers of the land that sank before the kings fell; Teku-Sul is the nearest to Lilmoth; the drowned priests' attendants still walk its east halls and strike at divers, a great mudcrab keeps one gallery, and her divers pray before they go in. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: Sees-Below. Tells: the station's head diver; he has touched Teku-Sul's gate and would give a year's share to see it open. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: (the ghost speaks first) Who comes to the gate?
topics.intent: The Ghost of Sul-Xeeth, first speaker of this shared topic, before the gate. Tells: he was a priest of the last king; when the king fell, his priests shut the tower's lowest halls, the way to the Root, behind this gate; they cut three seal-stones, one for each socket, and sent them far apart so that no one hand could open it; set all three and the gate opens, no fewer; one went with a masked thief who sought the Eye and died in the cells of Blackrose Prison, and the warden took it into his vault; one lies in the flooded vaults of Gemin; one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 30.

topics.label: Tell me again where the stones lie.
topics.intent: The Ghost of Sul-Xeeth. Tells: Blackrose Prison, in the warden's vault; Gemin, in its drowned lowest hall; Vorannuhl, behind a bronze-locked door in its deepest hall. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: The Ghost of Sul-Xeeth. Tells: a priest of the old kings, who served in this tower when it stood in air; he keeps the gate until all three stones come back. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: The gate at Teku-Sul needs three seal-stones, and I know where they are.
topics.intent: Never-Writes-Twice. Tells: she makes the player a Reel-Ka, "Warrior", the order's third rank, and gives the order's heavier cuirass and helm, three hundred gold and a free bed in every Archwarden fort; her orders are to take all three stones before the Unbound do; she marks Blackrose Prison, Gemin and Vorannuhl and says to take them in any order, Blackrose the least dangerous and Vorannuhl the worst. Checks: nothing. Does: sets stage 90 (91 if Fort Chalkmoth is done).

topics.label: What does Reel-Ka mean?
topics.intent: Never-Writes-Twice answering the shared topic (first written by Nesh-Deeka in MN05). Tells: Reel-Ka is "Warrior"; above it are Ka-Deelith, "War-Teacher", and Toh-Nassa, "Leader of the Secret". Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

state.notes: Notes: I am a Reel-Ka Warrior of the Archwardens. I have the Reel-Ka Cuirass, the Reel-Ka Helm and about 300 gold. I may still carry the Unbound Recipe for the Seal. The marker stone points to Teku-Sul Spire, west of Bell Station, off Lilmoth. Its Kings Gate has three empty sockets and needs all three seal-stones. The ghost of the priest Sul-Xeeth explained this, and the gate leads to the lowest halls and the Root. The stones are at the Blackrose Prison warden vault (least dangerous), the flooded vaults of Gemin, and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (worst). Never-Writes-Twice wants all three before the Unbound get them, and Vanin is digging ahead of us. Still open: Fort Chalkmoth, the cellar that moans, on Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. Cuts-the-Old-Knot and the Toh-Reel-Ka are tied to it. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, which I find suspicious. I got to Teku-Sul without buying waterbreathing, apparently because I am Argonian. Next: Blackrose Prison, or Fort Chalkmoth.

know_text: Grey Tooth quest done. The Grey Tooth cave niche was empty; a rubbing said the stone went to the Stormwidow, beached on Skeith Isle south-west shore. I took the Kings Marker Stone from its ballast crate (Unbound scouts were there; a wounded scout, Tah-Leesh, did not fight). I also took the Unbounds Recipe for the Seal, signed C.: grey caps and dried root ground into paste, numbs, pressed into the scar after the drawing. I still carry it. I gave the stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom and got 100 gold. She says the seven towers are the drowned spires off Lilmoth in Benthic Yobesh; the divers of Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth reached by boat from Lilmoth, know which tower is marked. Tah-Leesh said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Archwarden fort, Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, which I find suspicious. Next: Bell Station for the tower, or Fort Chalkmoth first. The Collector Vanin is also digging ahead of us.
